name: Exclusive Prostitute/Chamber Maid room ♂ 1 no Eru
original_name: 専属娼年/チェインバーメイドroom ♂ 1 のえる
source:
In exchange for taking care of his daily needs,
Eru became a boy who serves as his master’s personal maid.

Unlike the usual check-ins, today’s visit was intended to fulfill the true purpose of their arrangement.
translation:
作为照顾他日常需要的交换，
艾尔成为一名少年，担任主人的贴身女仆。

与平常的签到不同，今天的来访，是为了实现他们安排的真正目的。
